# Recover a typed value from flattened Variant bytes

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Box the I32 value 42. Carry its type descriptor alongside the bytes through the decoder. An I32 specimen of zero selects the output type and the recovered value is 42.

## What this example demonstrates

Box the I32 value 42. Carry its type descriptor alongside the bytes through the decoder. An I32 specimen of zero selects the output type and the recovered value is 42.
